name: maestro-desktop
description: Central desktop local-first para agentes de IA

scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @maestro/contracts build && pnpm --filter @maestro/core build && pnpm --filter @maestro/database build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @maestro/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @maestro/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @maestro/database typecheck && pnpm --filter @maestro/desktop typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @maestro/contracts test && pnpm --filter @maestro/core test && pnpm --filter @maestro/database test && pnpm --filter @maestro/desktop test
